hook_patterns: Paradoxical statements that challenge a positive trait (e.g., Peacemakers aren't calm, they're tired)
Absurd historical/scientific psychological experiments visualized simply
Bizarre crime or social scenarios where psychological biases cause counter-intuitive actions
todays_angle: Use Leo and Mia's comedic dynamic to expose counter-intuitive psychological phenomena that reframe daily human quirks as hilarious survival glitches.
ideas: Mia paints their living room Baker-Miller Pink to stop Leo from hyper-fixating on video games, leading to a dynamic breakdown of environmental psychology.
Leo acts as Mia's unhelpful 'accomplice' in overthinking a simple text reply to demonstrate the Bystander Effect inside one's own brain.
Mia proves Leo isn't a good listener by using the 'Illusion of Transparency' bias while Leo aggressively insists he can read her mind.
avoid: Generic dark-romance psychological facts like 'If your crush ignores you...' that rely on edgy text overlays
Melodramatic aesthetic slideshows with melancholic music and zero dialogue or character interaction
